items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I used to drive from Washington all the way up to Connecticut to make $75.00

ctx.x: But, there were long periods of droughts in between.

Yes - whereI was taking jobs like for instance, you take Red Balaban -- he was always very ambitious and he had a lot of jobs up in Connecticut. And, I used to drive from Washington all the way up to Connecticut to make $75.00. And,these things. But, this is how I had to survive this thing; you can't give up.
